$comment: The eval gate's verdict (runs/<run_id>/evaluation/gate.json). The prompt never named this file or its shape, and four live runs of the same prompt wrote it four ways -- the metrics under gate_results, decisions, results, or gates_applied; verdicts decisive_pass, pass_decisive, fail_decisive; counts as "87/120" under count or counts, or as n alone. The provenance card and the Outcome tab read it with a reader that guessed among the four (pipeline/contracts/provenance.py GATE_SHAPES), so a fifth spelling would have dropped the scores from both without an error. The driver validates every eval gate stage_complete against this file (pipeline/contracts/gate_contract.py) and rejects one that does not match, with the errors, so the agent rewrites it in the same session. Extra keys are allowed -- the agent may add detail -- but the keys below may not vary.
